entities.summary: Kenneth Rogers Murray Jr. is an American professional football linebacker. He played college football for the Oklahoma Sooners and was selected by the Los Angeles Chargers in the first round of the 2020 NFL draft. He signed with the Tennessee Titans in 2024 before being traded to the Cowboys in 2025.
